opening.argument: The speaker presents paid mining shares as a one-time payment that produces continuing returns, saying, "this is pay one time but get paid forever and ever and ever and ever." He describes participants funding equipment and splitting the mined Bitcoin, while the displayed BitClub page offers mining-pool share purchase tiers with Buy Now buttons. The promotion also promises recurring compensation from referrals' repurchases, directs part of mined Bitcoin toward "new equipment," and says participants will gain more shares in the pools. The commission history, wallet interface, and external signup direction support that promotional mechanism. The separate CoinPay payday and free-spins advertisement is not established as connected to these offers.
